title: chronos-rehearsal-with-differential-consistency-checks
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Context: We need a deterministic rehearsal path that can run production cohort snapshots against candidate model versions and produce a compact, auditable differential consistency report to drive automated rollback decisions. This PR implements 'Chronos Rehearsal', a coordinated snapshot-replay runner plus a differential consistency check engine.
Goals: 1) enable safe dry-run of model promotes using production traffic snapshots, 2) surface token-level and outcome-level divergences (KL, token-error rate, response-structure drift), 3) produce a single pass/fail signal that can be used by rollout orchestration to auto-backout or escalate to human review.
What changed (summary):
- runtime/rehearsal/runner: new Chronos runner that accepts cohort snapshot manifests, replays requests with preserved timing semantics, and collects deterministic inputs/outputs including KV cache warmup traces
- runtime/rehearsal/diff: differential engine that computes multi-dimensional metrics (KL over token logits, normalized BLEU-like string divergence for short generations, latency distribution shift, structured-output schema mismatches) and combines them into an explainable score
- api/console: new "Rehearsal Runs" page in Console with run timeline, top-k divergence traces, and per-cohort artifact downloads
- api: POST /v1/rehearsals start endpoint + GET status/GET artifacts endpoints
- orchestration: rollout adapter that triggers a Chronos rehearsal as a pre-promote gate; exposes an auto-rollback predicate when weighted-diff-score > threshold or when divergence persists on core metrics
- telemetry: new metrics and histograms: rehearsal.run.duration, rehearsal.diff.score, rehearsal.kv.warmups, rehearsal.token_divergence.p95
- infra: small job spec templates for Dedicated and Private that mount snapshot artifacts and run the runner with safe resource caps
- tests: deterministic integration test harness that replays a fixed 1k-record snapshot and asserts stable diff scores across runs
Why this is safe: rehearsal runs are read-only and run in sandboxed worker pools, snapshots are immutable and sanitized by the snapshot pipeline. The default rollout integration runs Chronos on a small seed cohort (1% traffic equivalent) and requires human opt-in to expand beyond 10% traffic until the score history is clean for 72h.
Rollback logic: the adapter supports three outcomes: pass -> continue, warn -> pause and human review, fail -> immediate reversal of promote and create an incident. The fail predicate is configurable; default uses weighted thresholds: token_divergence.p95 > 0.12 OR KL_avg > 0.25 OR schema_mismatch_rate > 0.02.
Developer checklist:
- [x] unit tests for diff functions
- [x] integration test for runner with small snapshot
- [x] Console UI wired to artifacts
- [x] rollout adapter integration tests
- [x] docs drafted (docs/rehearsal.md)
- [x] e2e smoke on staging CI
Notes about implementation details: Chronos preserves original inter-request spacing up to a configurable scale factor so timing-sensitive models are exercised; KV warming is replayed for session-scoped cohorts to approximate realistic cache states; the diff engine supports pluggable comparators for structured outputs (JSON-LD path checks) and a small scripted verifier for privacy-safe token redaction.
Backwards compatibility and migration: existing rollout policies without a rehearsal step continue to work. The rollout adapter is opt-in via policy field "pre_promote_rehearsal: chronos". For Dedicated/Private customers, the job spec includes a hint to use a local snapshot mount.
Operational considerations: rehearsal artifacts are stored for 30 days by default and can be configured per-org. Rehearsal runs are meterable (tokens+compute) and bill to the customer's reserved pool in Dedicated.
Security: snapshot ingestion pipeline applies PII removal and redaction; worker pools run under a restricted service account.
Related work items: ENG-6789 (rehearsal infra), ENG-6790 (diff comparators), SUP-1023 (customer request to gate promotions).
Rollout plan: feature flagged on main; enable in staging for 2 weeks, run smoke rehearsals on top 5 models, collect baseline diffs, then gradually enable orchestration adapter in production for internal orgs only.
Merge method: squash-merge.
Migration steps for platform operators: run `rehearsalctl migrate-v1` to create default job specs, update rollout policies to reference pre_promote_rehearsal where desired.
"Commit summary" and small snippet: added runner entrypoint and diff lambda; sample adapter config: "pre_promote_rehearsal: { type: 'chronos', seed_fraction: 0.01, auto_rollback: true }".
commits: init: add chronos rehearsal runner and basic replay loop
ui: add rehearsal runs page and artifacts API
tests: deterministic replay harness and adapter tests
review_comments: Ana Morales: Nice isolation model, but can we avoid replaying KV entries that include PII? Please add a toggle to disable KV warmups per org.
Priya Natarajan: Good catch — added sanitization step and org-level kv_warmup_allowed flag; updated docs to call this out.
Kenji Sato: The weighted-diff composite score needs a bit more explanation; request a short section in docs showing how weights map to failure modes.
Priya Natarajan: Added 'diff weight tuning' section in docs/rehearsal.md and added a small example JSON showing thresholds.
checks_summary: Initial CI run failed on flaky integration test; rerun passed after fixture stabilization. All unit tests and linters pass. E2E smoke in staging passed on macrotask instance. Security scan flagged no high-severity issues.
release_notes: Adds Chronos Rehearsal: a snapshot-driven rehearsal runner and differential consistency checks that can be used as a pre-promote gate. Opt-in rollout adapter and Console UI included. Default safe thresholds and storage policies applied. See docs/rehearsal.md for configuration and operational guidance.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps the rehearsal runner behind a feature flag and opt-in rollout policies to minimize blast radius. We will monitor rehearsal.run.duration and rehearsal.diff.score for the first week after rollout.
